en_title: Naughty Dog Dev: GTA 6 Appears to Him as ‘as a Bugatti Veyron Would to a Nervous Victorian Child’
cn_title: 顽皮狗开发者：在他看来，《GTA 6》就像「一辆布加迪威航出现在一个紧张不安的维多利亚时代孩子面前」
opus_summary: 顽皮狗世界设计总监Michael Barclay表示，拥有19年游戏开发经验的他，看到《GTA 6》就像维多利亚时代紧张的孩子看到布加迪威航。多名开发者也表达了类似的震撼。文章称，《GTA 6》首发24小时零售额达到37.9亿美元(约合人民币253亿元)。

paragraphs.en: Just like the rest of us, developers the world over are playing GTA 6. Just like the rest of us, they’re also finding themselves blown away by just how dramatically advanced and impressive GTA 6 is proving to be. However, as professionals with a far, far firmer idea of how the sausage gets made than regular punters, precisely how impressed some developers are is speaking volumes about just what a technical achievement GTA 6 really does represent.
paragraphs.cn: 和我们其他人一样，世界各地的开发者都在玩《GTA 6》。也和我们其他人一样，他们也为《GTA 6》展现出的巨大技术进步和惊人表现所震撼。不过，作为比普通玩家更清楚游戏究竟是如何制作出来的专业人士，一些开发者所受到的震撼程度，充分说明了《GTA 6》在技术上究竟取得了怎样的成就。

paragraphs.en: Naughty Dog world design director Michael Barclay, presently working on Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, minces no words.
paragraphs.cn: 目前正在开发《星际：异端先知》的顽皮狗世界设计总监Michael Barclay直言不讳。

paragraphs.en: “I’ve made video games for 19 years and GTA VI appears to me as a Bugatti Veyron would to a nervous Victorian child,” writes Barclay via social media.
paragraphs.cn: Barclay在社交媒体上写道：「我做了19年电子游戏，而《GTA 6》在我面前，就像一辆布加迪威航出现在一个紧张不安的维多利亚时代孩子面前。」

paragraphs.en: Barclay is far from alone, with a host of developers in the replies to Barclay’s comment expressing like sentiments in the days following GTA 6’s release.
paragraphs.cn: 有这种感受的远不止Barclay一人。在《GTA 6》发售后的几天里，许多开发者在Barclay这番评论的回复中表达了类似的感受。

paragraphs.en: Payday 2 game director David Goldfarb, who previously worked on Mirror’s Edge and a variety of Battlefield games, is similarly stunned.
paragraphs.cn: 《Payday 2》游戏总监David Goldfarb同样感到震惊，他此前曾参与开发《Mirror’s Edge》和多款《战地风云》游戏。

paragraphs.en: “Been making games over 30 years… Can’t even find words for what I’m playing now,” he writes , later noting he’s “never been this floored by anything ever.”
paragraphs.cn: 他写道：「我做游戏已经超过30年了……甚至找不到词来形容我现在玩到的东西。」他后来表示，自己「从未被任何东西如此震撼过」。

paragraphs.en: Character artist Del Walker (Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League, The Last of Us: Part II, Star Wars: Jedi - Survivor) quips he simply can’t explain what he’s seeing despite his background in the business.
paragraphs.cn: 曾参与《Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League》《最后生还者 第二部》和《Star Wars: Jedi - Survivor》制作的角色美术师Del Walker打趣说，尽管自己有从业背景，却根本无法解释眼前看到的东西。

paragraphs.en: “Every GTA clip gets sent to me in the group chat with. ‘You’re a game dev. How did they do this?” he writes. “Brother, I wasn’t there when they opened the portal? This is not magic I recognize.”
paragraphs.cn: 他写道：「群聊里每次给我发《侠盗猎车手》的片段，都会问：『你是游戏开发者。他们是怎么做到的？』兄弟，他们打开传送门的时候我又不在场？这不是我认识的魔法。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 arrived late last week, smashing records as the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with retail sales reaching $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours. In my review for IGN I called it “the single most impressive video game I have ever played,” something that is making increasingly more sense to me the more other developers I note making comments like the above.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》于上周晚些时候发售，打破纪录，成为有史以来规模最大的娱乐产品首发，头24小时的零售销售额达到37.9亿美元。我在为IGN撰写的评测中称它是「我玩过的最令人惊叹的电子游戏，没有之一」。随着我注意到越来越多其他开发者发表上述类似评论，我越发觉得这句话很有道理。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6, or wondering what to do next? You can get stuck into the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN, consult our Beginner's Guide or Leonida interactive map , or get an idea of all the incredible flourishes to keep an eye out for by checking out our look at 99 incredible details you can find in GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？你可以直接在IGN上阅读《GTA 6》官方指南，查阅我们的新手指南或Leonida互动地图，也可以看看我们整理的《GTA 6》中能发现的99个不可思议的细节，了解值得留意的各种精彩细节。
